questiontext.text: Which of the following are essential rules for safely operating a domestic gasoline generator? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Generators must be positioned outdoors at least 20 feet away on level ground with exhausts directed away from windows. Indoor use and hot refueling are lethal hazards.

questiontext.text: Which of the following actions should be taken immediately upon smelling gas in a domestic kitchen? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Safely handling a gas leak requires shutting the cylinder valve, opening windows, and evacuating. Never strike matches or toggle electrical switches.

questiontext.text: Which of the following are practical methods of residential target hardening? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Deadbolts, burglary bars, and motion floodlights harden targets. Leaving gates open and displaying cash invite crime.

questiontext.text: Which of the following are recognized forms of bullying in school environments? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Physical violence, relational exclusion, and cyberbullying are authentic forms of bullying. Healthy debates and teamwork are constructive.

questiontext.text: Which of the following behavioral cues represent immediate "Red Flags" when interacting with an unfamiliar adult? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Demanding secrets, offering bribery for vehicle rides, and luring into alleys are major red flags. Crossing guards and librarians perform normal duties.

questiontext.text: Match each category of crime with its correct legal definition:

generalfeedback.text: Theft is dishonest taking; Burglary is nocturnal home breaking; Battery is physical force; Arson is willful setting of fire.

questiontext.text: Match each fire class with its corresponding fuel source:

generalfeedback.text: Class A is solid combustibles; Class B is flammable liquids; Class C is flammable gases; Class F/K is cooking oils and fats.

questiontext.text: Match each security agency or body with its primary statutory function:

generalfeedback.text: NSCDC protects infrastructure; School Safety Committees manage school safety; Neighborhood Watch provides community surveillance; 112 is the emergency line.

questiontext.text: Match each crime prevention strategy with its practical execution:

generalfeedback.text: Natural surveillance trims hedges and illuminates; Target hardening uses locks and bars; Access control checks visitor logs; Safe havens provide refuge.

questiontext.text: Match each suspicious situation with its proper defensive countermeasure:

generalfeedback.text: Trailing cars require turning 180 degrees; stranger candy offers require refusal and alert; uncomfortable secrets must be told to parents; claims of injury require the code word.
